title: Normalized condensed smooth-purity maps
statement: Fix a prime ℓ and a field k of characteristic p > 0 with p ≠ ℓ. Let X,Y be separated finite-type k-schemes and f:X→Y smooth of pure relative dimension d. In the ambient derived category of modules over the condensed coefficient ring, there are mutually inverse maps between the bounded-constructible exceptional inverse image of the coefficient unit and the shifted Tate twist: writing A for the former and B for the latter, there are u:A⟶B and v:B⟶A with u≫v=𝟙_A and v≫u=𝟙_B. These maps are the normalized finite-coefficient diagonal/DNC reconstruction maps.

source.place: Normalized finite-coefficient diagonal/DNC reconstruction and condensed coefficient transport

proof.text: The finite diagonal and deformation-to-the-normal-cone smooth-purity maps are compatible with coefficient reduction. The coherent adic tower and its condensed realization transport those maps to the displayed condensed module objects, and the two finite-level inverse identities survive the exact reconstruction. This is the normalized geometric reconstruction step of the smooth-purity argument.
